cards.card_text: Fatlings, rams, bulls AND goats, with the fragrant smoke going up.
cards.verse_text: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats.
cards.snippet: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer…

cards.card_text: The leopard will lie down with the goat, and the calf, the young lion and the fatling will all be together.
cards.verse_text: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the goat; the calf and young lion and fatling will be together, and a little child will lead them.
cards.snippet: …will lie down with the goat; the calf and young lion and fatling will be together, and a little child will lead them.
